description: Castopod is a free, open-source podcast hosting platform made for podcasters who want to engage and interact with their audience: publish episodes, follow download analytics, and federate with the Fediverse over ActivityPub, with Podcasting 2.0 features built in.
name: Castopod
seoDescription: Deploy Castopod with Docker Compose on Dokploy — the open-source podcast hosting platform with MariaDB, Redis, Fediverse federation and Podcasting 2.0 support.
